title: Preserve array values across the Lua host boundary
description:
As a procedure author, I want structured array parameters to remain arrays when passed into Python host modules, so exact scoped operations receive their documented contract.

Out of scope: relaxing selector validation or adding another execution path.

Feature: Lua host array conversion

  Scenario: Pass an array through a host module call
    Given a JSON array was decoded into a sequential Lua table
    When a procedure calls a Python host module with that value
    Then the Python handler receives a list in the same order
    And nested mappings remain mappings

  Scenario: Preserve non-sequential Lua mappings
    Given a Lua table has non-sequential or named keys
    When it crosses the host boundary
    Then the Python handler receives a mapping without discarded entries

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: The registered host boundary already preserves sequential Lua tables. The reproduced value was a string because the procedure CLI did not parse JSON arrays in --set. The caller-side fix and regressions are tracked by plx-497e08; no host-boundary change is needed.
